scope: Audivane native desktop x64 (Linux baseline; Windows reuses the same pinned sources)

components.name: FFmpeg / ffprobe
components.role: Native executables. Codec libraries are statically linked; glibc/libm remain dynamic.
components.notes: Configured without --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree. The exact ./configure line and every static dependency archive hash are in VERSION.txt.

components.name: Google liblc3
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable; also built into the optional browser LC3 module.

components.name: libsoxr
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable (resampling).

components.name: libogg
components.role: Static dependency of libvorbis and the native FFmpeg executable (Ogg container).

components.name: libvorbis
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable (Vorbis encoder/decoder).

components.name: libopus
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable (Opus encoder/decoder).

components.name: LAME / libmp3lame
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable (MP3 encoder).

components.name: TwoLAME / libtwolame
components.role: Static dependency of the native FFmpeg executable (MP2 encoder).

components.name: AOSP libldac (LDAC encoder)
components.role: Statically linked into ldac_helper and the optional browser LDAC module.

archive.contentSha256Algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative file paths, types, sizes and bytes after extraction; Android Gitiles regenerates archive bytes per request

components.name: hegdi/libldacdec (LDAC decoder)
components.role: Statically linked into ldac_helper and the optional browser LDAC module.

localAssets.name: Electron / Chromium / Node.js
localAssets.notes: The Electron packager preserves these files in the packaged runtime. Do not replace them with the project MIT license.

localAssets.name: IBM Plex Sans
localAssets.notes: Copied with the client build; keep beside the font assets.

localAssets.name: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg and @ffmpeg/core
localAssets.notes: Browser-only assets. The desktop distribution deliberately excludes the unused WASM codec assets (owned by the root packaging change). The web bundle still distributes the GPL core and needs its own exact corresponding-source payload before public web release.

localAssets.name: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg wrapper
localAssets.notes: The MIT wrapper JavaScript is retained in shared client bundles even when native desktop execution excludes browser codec binaries.

localAssets.name: Recorded Windows cross and NSIS build packages
localAssets.notes: Exact package URLs and hashes used for this cross-produced candidate. These are build inputs, not executables shipped to users.

knownGapsBeforePublicRelease: The @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 GPL corresponding source/build payload for the web bundle is not part of this native materials set.
Codec patent/licensing policy for intended release regions is a legal review, not established by archive collection.
Windows x64 binaries reuse these pinned sources but require their own baseline build and provenance audit.
